label.zh: 技术报告（9 月 15 日开放）

zh.title: ScienceBuddy · AI 科研搭档：DFM 框架下的智能研究工作环境
zh.summary: ScienceBuddy 将递归式科研智能体与 Science IDE 连接起来，把科学问题、文献、数据、代码、工具和实验方案纳入同一个课题工作区。当前已提供可访问的产品入口。
body: ScienceBuddy 是 DFM 框架下重点展示的具体产品形态，也是科学家可以直接接触和使用的 AI 科研搭档。
它将递归式科研智能体与 Science IDE 连接起来，把科学问题、文献、数据、代码、工具和实验方案纳入同一个课题工作区。系统沿着“探索—执行—评估—改进”的循环推进长程科研任务，科学家可以随时查看、介入并复核研究过程。
ScienceBuddy 主要用于承接和结构化科学问题、数据需求、研究材料、文献和代码、科研工具调用、假设形成与验证，以及后续科研工作流所需的信息。
ScienceBuddy 是 DFM 框架下科学家能够直接使用的智能研究工作环境，也是本次发布中展示 DFM 如何进入真实科研过程的重要模块。它不是独立于 DFM 的另一个技术方向。
当前已提供可访问的产品入口，具体能力范围和开放方式以实际版本为准。真实案例将在获得相关研究者授权后逐步公开。

en.title: ScienceBuddy · AI Research Partner: a research workspace under DFM
en.summary: ScienceBuddy connects a recursive research agent with a Science IDE, bringing scientific questions, literature, data, code, tools and experiment plans into one workspace. A product entry point is available now.
body: ScienceBuddy is the product form of DFM shown in this release, and the AI research partner scientists can reach and use directly.

It connects a recursive research agent with a Science IDE, bringing scientific questions, literature, data, code, tools and experiment plans into one workspace. The system advances long-running research through an explore–execute–evaluate–improve loop, and scientists can inspect, intervene and verify each step.

ScienceBuddy takes in and structures scientific questions, data needs, research materials, literature and code, research tool calls, hypothesis formation and validation, and the information later research workflows need.

ScienceBuddy is the research environment under DFM that scientists can use directly, and the module in this release that shows how DFM enters real research. It is not a separate technical direction beside DFM.
A product entry point is available now; the scope of capabilities and access follow the current version. Real cases will be shared as the researchers involved give their permission.
